text: For, behold, the day{H3117} cometh,{H935} it burneth{H1197} as a furnace;{H8574} and all the proud,{H2086} and all that work{H6213} wickedness,{H7564} shall be stubble;{H7179} and the day{H3117} that cometh{H935} shall burn them up,{H3857} saith{H559} Jehovah{H3068} of hosts,{H6635} that it shall leave{H5800} them neither root{H8328} nor branch.{H6057}
